text:
Helen (People Ops): Quick thread 1 line: Raj (offer accepted) will relocate to our London office and needs a Skilled Worker visa (sponsorship). We need CoS issuance, salary confirmation (meets UK threshold), RWR checks, and relocation package sign-off. Can we triage?
Tom S (Recruiter): Offer signed. Start target is Aug 2, 2026. Base salary in offer: GBP 85,000. Role: Senior Inference Engineer, UK office (onsite 3 days/wk).
Aisha (UK Counsel): Key checklist: 1) confirm Certificate of Sponsorship (CoS) allocation from UK sponsor quota, 2) confirm salary meets Skilled Worker minimum and going rate (both apply), 3) obtain Right to Work (RWR) documents + criminal record check advice if requested, 4) prepare employer letter for visa. Also need to register sponsor licence details (Sponsor ID) on letter.
Nina (Hiring Manager): Role blurb for letter: "Raj will join as Senior Inference Engineer on Serving Runtime UK. Responsibilities: lead low-latency kernel optimization, own inference integration for EMEA customers, transfer model sharding knowledge to onsite team." OK?
Helen (People Ops): Good. Tom, please confirm that GBP 85k satisfies the UK Skilled Worker rules (going rate and general threshold). Aisha, can you validate and advise if we need to top up salary or add a recruitment statement?
Tom S (Recruiter): Per preliminary check, going rate for Senior Engineer band is GBP 70k; general salary threshold is GBP 26,200 but Skilled Worker also needs going rate or listed occupation rate. GBP 85k should be fine but confirm with counsel. I'll attach the signed offer to this thread.
Aisha (UK Counsel): Confirmed: GBP 85,000 exceeds both the general threshold and the SOC-advised going rate for the role. No salary uplift required. Next: we need candidate passport scan, biometrics appointment booking details, and a UK address for the CoS.
Raj (candidate): I DM'ed passport scan to Helen and shared a UK address where I'll stay for first month (Airbnb). Also: asked about dependents (partner) — do we sponsor partner under Dependant route?
Helen (People Ops): Thanks. On dependents: we can sponsor dependants if they apply with Raj's Skilled Worker visa; cost/immigration fees and healthcare surcharge apply. Need opt-in confirmation from candidate and funds/fee guidance. Tom, please confirm if partner is applying.
Tom S (Recruiter): Raj confirmed partner will apply as dependent. I'll send them the dependants checklist (Immigration fees, Immigration Health Surcharge, evidence of relationship, funds).
Global Mobility: Note: for UK relocation, we must run a payroll and tax residency plan. Contractor stipends differ. Also, GBP 85k will be paid via UK payroll once local entity onboarding complete; initial 4 weeks can be payroll via UK entity or reimbursed via expense depending on start date. Need to know Raj's proposed worksite address and start date to set up local payroll.
Payroll Bot: Action: to set up UK payroll we need NI onboarding forms, UK bank details, and right-to-work evidence before first payroll run. If the employee is on UK payroll after arrival, local statutory deductions apply. Provide estimated relocation date so we can schedule payroll run.
Helen (People Ops): Action items I'm capturing: (1) Aisha to prepare employer letter + CoS request draft; (2) Tom to confirm dependants flow and upload passport; (3) Global Mobility & Payroll to advise on payroll timing and relocation stipend; (4) Nina to sign off onsite schedule. Target to request CoS by May 5 to allow smooth visa timelines—any objections?
Nina (Hiring Manager): No objections. Onsite requirement approved (3 days/week) and internal buddy assigned (Clara) for local onboarding.
Aisha (UK Counsel): Draft employer letter snippet below, please review: ```Date: Apr 26, 2026
To: Entry Clearance Officer
Re: Skilled Worker Visa support for Raj Patel (passport: X12345678)

Redwood Inference confirms an offer to Raj Patel for the role of Senior Inference Engineer at our UK site. Salary: GBP 85,000 per annum. Start date: 02 Aug 2026. Raj will work primarily from our London office (TW1 1AA) on a hybrid basis (3 days per week). Sponsor Licence Number: 4X1-REDWOOD-UK (example).

Please contact Helen at people-ops@redwood.ai for verification.```
Aisha (UK Counsel): I'll prepare formal CoS request and attach this letter. Expect 48 hours to generate CoS once sponsor allocation confirmed.
Tom S (Recruiter): I've uploaded partner's documents and Raj's passport to /candidates/raj_patel/visa. Also sent candidate an estimated cost sheet for dependants (IHS + application fees).
Raj (candidate): Thanks 3 - appreciate the clarity. One Q: will Redwood cover immigration fees or IHS for dependants? Offer mentioned relocation stipend but not explicitly dependants fees.
Helen (People Ops): Policy: dependent visa fees and IHS are typically paid by the employee unless otherwise agreed. For senior hires we sometimes offer a contribution. Nina, any guidance on offering a dependent fee contribution?
Nina (Hiring Manager): We can approve a one-time contribution of up to GBP 1,500 towards dependent visa costs for senior ICs. Approve if requested.
Global Mobility: Note for compliance: if dependants enroll in UK benefits immediate after arrival, payroll needs to be set to UK entity. Also ensure pension auto-enrolment obligations are addressed once on UK payroll.
Payroll Bot: Reminder: Sponsor must confirm employment contract and UK worksite address for CoS. Once CoS assigned, the candidate applies for visa online and books biometrics. Upload visa decision timeline to candidate folder.
Aisha (UK Counsel): Next steps: 1) Confirm sponsor allocation with Home Office portal and request CoS (Aisha); 2) Helen/Tom collect passport + partner docs (Tom); 3) Global Mobility/PAYROLL to confirm payroll cutover plan; 4) Nina to sign relocation contribution approval if Raj requests dependent fee support. I'll aim to request CoS by May 3.
Helen (People Ops): Thanks all. Please ack here when you've completed your action. I'll post the final CoS reference and employer letter once Aisha confirms. :white_check_mark:
Tom S (Recruiter): Ack 1 passport & partner docs uploaded.
Aisha (UK Counsel): Ack 1 CoS request in progress.
Global Mobility: Ack 1 coordinating payroll cutover plan.
Payroll Bot: Ack 1 awaiting NI & bank details for payroll creation.
Raj (candidate): Ack 1 will let you know if partner applies for contribution.
people-ops-bot: Thread saved to #people-ops for compliance audit.
